values.title: Multi-tenant apps with row-level rules
values.summary: A practical pattern for isolating customer data.
values.body:
## Isolate data with rules

The simplest multi-tenant design keeps one set of tables and adds a tenant column. Row-level rules then guarantee that each request can only see the rows that belong to its own tenant.

## A practical pattern

Add a tenant id to every table, write one shared rule, and test it on a preview branch before it reaches production.
